compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

Implement check-session-branch-invariant.sh to make T7 tests pass.

## Acceptance Criteria (from DD6)

- Scans session branch git log for merge commits from story/* branches
- For each such merge commit, checks for DSO-Story-Merge: trailer in commit message
- Missing trailer → exits non-zero, prints offending SHA to stderr
- All merge commits have trailer (or none exist) → exits 0

## Files to create
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-session-branch-invariant.sh (executable via chmod +x)

## Implementation approach
```bash
git log --merges --format='%H %s' | grep 'story/' | while read sha msg; do
  if ! git log -1 --format=%B "$sha" | grep -q '^DSO-Story-Merge:'; then
    echo "ERROR: merge commit $sha missing DSO-Story-Merge trailer" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
```

## Notes
- This is a POST-HOC AUDIT, not a pre-commit hook
- Distinction from check-session-merge-only.sh: that guards individual commits at pre-commit time; this verifies aggregate history at validation time — catches cherry-picks or bypassed pre-commit
- ShellCheck clean
